verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents SAML 2.0 single sign-on for enterprise applications. OIDC is covered only through generic Custom OAuth/OIDC providers rather than an enterprise SSO flow, and a community user was unsure whether OIDC-based SSO is supported. That question does not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: enterprise-grade OIDC SSO documentation, named setup guidance for Okta, Entra and Google Workspace, workforce SSO controls such as domain routing or per-tenant connections, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: Add Single Sign-On for enterprise applications with SAML 2.0.
To add a provider that isn't listed, use [Custom OAuth/OIDC Providers](/docs/guides/auth/custom-oauth-providers).
It works with any OAuth2 or OIDC-compatible identity provider.
